text: ラッキーに　もたせると　わざが　あいての　きゅうしょに　あたりやすくなる　グローブ。

structure.jp: ラッキーに　もたせると
structure.en: when you have Chansey hold it

structure.jp: わざが　あいての　きゅうしょに　あたりやすくなる
structure.en: its moves become more likely to hit the foe's vital spots

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. もたせると = 'when you have it hold this'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means the action happens easily. Here it is in its く shape because なる follows. あたりやすく = 'easily hitting'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あたりやすくなる　グローブ
patterns.explanation: Everything before グローブ describes the glove, the way 'that...' does in English. あたりやすくなる　グローブ = 'a glove that makes them hit more easily'.
